subject: Life Skills
title: The Cost of Context Switching
description: A fast breakdown of The Cost of Context Switching for builders.

hook.text: Every time you switch tasks, your brain takes 23 minutes to fully refocus. You checked Slack four times this hour.

buildup.text: Gloria Mark at UC Irvine tracked knowledge workers. They averaged just 3 minutes on a task before switching.

discovery.text: Context switching leaves 'attention residue.' Part of your brain is still solving the previous problem.

twist.text: Multitasking feels productive. Brain scans show it actually lowers IQ more than skipping a night of sleep.

climax.text: Batch similar tasks together. Reply to all emails at once, then close your inbox and do deep work in one block.

punchline.text: Switching is not working. It is restarting.

quiz.question: What is 'attention residue'?
options: Feeling tired after a long workday
Part of your brain still processing the previous task after switching
The inability to remember details from earlier tasks
